name: Update Selling Price
script:
# Get default selling price list from Selling Settings
price_list = frappe.db.get_single_value("Selling Settings", "selling_price_list")
if not price_list:
    frappe.msgprint("No default Selling Price List set in Selling Settings.")

for item in doc.items:
    if not item.custom_selling_list_rate or not item.item_code:
        continue
    
    new_rate = item.custom_selling_list_rate
    
    # Find existing Item Price (selling)
    item_price_name = frappe.db.get_value(
        "Item Price",
        filters={
            "item_code": item.item_code,
            "price_list": price_list,
            "selling": 1
        },
        fieldname="name"
    )
    
    if item_price_name:
        # Update existing
        ip = frappe.get_doc("Item Price", item_price_name)
        ip.price_list_rate = new_rate
        ip.save(ignore_permissions=True)
    else:
        # Create new
        ip = frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "Item Price",
            "item_code": item.item_code,
            "price_list": price_list,
            "selling": 1,
            "price_list_rate": new_rate,
            "uom": item.uom or frappe.db.get_value("Item", item.item_code, "stock_uom")
        })
        ip.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
